description: Resolve (or reopen) a comment thread by comment id. Pass expectQuote (a snippet of the comment’s quoted text or body, from list_comments) — shown for confirmation and verified against the live comment, so a wrong/stale id is refused instead of resolving the wrong thread.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

expectQuote.description: snippet of the comment’s quoted text/body; verified before resolving

name: resolve_comment
title: Resolve or reopen a comment
